_source: Built by tools/scripts/build_p2_gamedata.py from Phantasie II, Atari ST v1.0 (reverse-engineering/atari-st/phantasie2/extracted/, FORMAT.md)
_note: The tables this folder holds and their sizes, read by OpenPhantasie.Data GameTables.Load (and GameDataRepository.Load for play, with Core's Phantasie2Campaign; 09-trilogy.md T3). Its Atari ST graphics pack is graphics/atari-st.json (not built by this script).
_spell_cost_rule: I: (DOS slot % 4) + 1 for every spell (OV2). II uses the same rule on its own slots [C] (magic-divine.md section 1: DIVINE II slot 56 = 1 MP, DIVINE I slot 57 = 2 MP); every spells.json cost is filled, but the checked rule stays null because the loader's slot map (SpellId.DosSlot) only knows I's numbering.
